edges.reason: setOwner is gated by the auth modifier which evaluates isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig)
setAuthority is gated by the auth modifier depending on msg.sender
isAuthorized compares src (msg.sender) against owner and authority.canCall
setOwnerByAdmin requires msg.sender to equal the admin address
setAdminByAdmin requires msg.sender to equal the current admin
kill is restricted by onlyOwner checking owner == msg.sender
withdrawStuckFunds is restricted by onlyOwner checking msg.sender
callExecute is restricted by onlyMonitor checking msg.sender == monitor
confirmNewMonitor uses now to enforce the CHANGE_PERIOD wait, a timestamp dependency
block.timestamp (now) is compared against changeRequestedTimestamp to gate monitor changes
AaveHelper.getFee consults BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to select the fee tier
CompoundSaverHelper.getFee consults BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to select the fee tier
MCDSaverProxy.getFee consults BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to select the fee tier
setOwner writes the owner state variable
setAuthority writes the authority state variable
isAuthorized reads authority and calls canCall on it
setOwnerByAdmin updates the owner state variable
setAdminByAdmin updates the admin state variable
changeMonitor stores the candidate in newMonitor
changeMonitor records now into changeRequestedTimestamp
confirmNewMonitor promotes newMonitor into the monitor state variable
callExecute invokes DSProxy.execute externally and then transfers leftover ETH to msg.sender, allowing re-entrancy
MCDMonitorProxyV2.callExecute performs an external DSProxy.execute call before returning leftover ETH
AaveMonitorProxy.callExecute performs an external DSProxy.execute call before returning leftover ETH
DFSProxy.callProxy forwards user calldata to DSProxy.execute via an external call
CompoundSaverFlashLoan.executeOperation calls DSProxy.execute externally mid-flow
LoanShifterReceiver.executeOperation calls DSProxy.execute twice while holding flash loan funds
kill executes selfdestruct(payable(owner))
write executes an assembly create over the supplied bytecode
_sell routes through takeOrder which performs a low-level external call
_buy routes through takeOrder which performs a low-level external call
AaveHelper.getFee transfers the computed fee to WALLET_ADDR
CompoundSaverHelper.getFee transfers the computed fee to WALLET_ADDR
SaverExchange.sell calls the internal _sell flow
SaverExchange.buy calls the internal _buy flow
_amount parameter drives the fee size and the 20 percent clamp
feeAmount = (_amount / fee) performs division and later multiplication without SafeMath on 0.6.6
_tokenAddr selects between ETH transfer and ERC20 safeTransfer
_gasCost is converted and added into the MCD fee amount
_data is forwarded to DSProxy.execute by callExecute
_newMonitor is stored into newMonitor during the monitor change procedure
_owner is assigned to the owner state variable inside setOwnerByAdmin
_admin is assigned to the admin state variable inside setAdminByAdmin
feeAmount local is the value ultimately transferred to the fee wallet
swapAmount local holds the swap result produced by _sell
destAmount local is the computed output amount of _sell

normalization_plan.reason: _owner only exists to update the owner state variable inside this core function
_admin only exists to update the admin state variable inside this core function
_amount is consumed directly by the fee computation in this core function
_tokenAddr only selects the ETH vs ERC20 transfer branch in this core function
_gasCost is folded directly into the fee amount computed by this core function
_data is only forwarded to the DSProxy.execute unsafe operation by this core function
_newMonitor is only stored into newMonitor by this core monitor-change function
feeAmount is a temporary value computed and immediately transferred inside this core function
swapAmount only holds the intermediate result produced by the core _sell flow
destAmount is the temporary output amount computed by the core _sell flow
